commands.name: test
commands.description: Run the Go tests (under -race) for the named package paths, in whichever module holds each one, e.g. ./host or ./ext/files/..., or in every module below one, e.g. ./ext/... Pass package paths only. To run one test, use run_test_one.

commands.name: test_one
commands.description: Run only the tests matching a -run pattern in one package, verbose and under -race. Pass one argument, the package path and the pattern joined by a colon, e.g. ./surfaces/chat:TestBannerLine or ./host:TestApproval|TestUndo. Fails if the pattern matches no test.

commands.name: test_all
commands.description: Run every module's tests under -race, as CI does. Slow (a few minutes): use it to confirm a finished change, and run_test while iterating.

commands.name: vet
commands.description: go vet every module and example.

commands.name: fmt_check
commands.description: Check that every Go file, new ones included, is gofmt-clean. Run it before saying a change is done; CI fails on unformatted files.
